text:
Maya: Heads up — TrellisPay showing a sharp usage drop this week and their CTO left last Friday. Renewal ~45 days out. We should triage before procurement goes quiet.

Raj: What magnitude of drop? seats or API calls?

Maya: Seats active calls down ~38% WoW, embedding & rerank API calls down 44%. Daily unique users from 120 -> 73.

Nora: I talked to their champion (Elena) yesterday. She said infra cost concerns + a new procurement lead wants a cost/latency RFP.

Maya: Adding details — renewal date 2026-05-07 (from CRM). Contract: Dedicated pool, 3 GPU nodes reserved.

renewal-bot: Renewal alert — TrellisPay (acct: TRE-001) renewal in 46 days. Last touch: 2026-02-28. Priority: high.

Lin: Thanks. Can we get recent route-level latency + cost breakdown for their top 5 routes? Procurement will ask.

Diego: I can pull per-route stats. Quick SQL to get daily token usage for last 30d:```sql
SELECT date(day) as d, sum(tokens) as tokens, count(distinct user_id) as users
FROM api_events
WHERE acct = 'TRE-001'
  AND day >= current_date - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY d
ORDER BY d;
```

Diego: I'll run that and post charts in ~45m.

Raj: Also need to know if they hit any rate limit errors or increased 5xxs — that can cause fallback and perceived instability.

Maya: I already checked logs — no spike in 5xx, but we see more 429s on embedding routes earlier this month when they increased batch size. Might be client-side batch change.

Nora: Elena mentioned a PoC with SkyServe AI evaluating cheaper quantized variants. They might be testing locally to shave 20-30% on cost.

Maya: Key asks for next 48h: 1) a short deck for procurement comparing cost/latency vs SkyServe for their workload; 2) enablement session for new procurement lead; 3) propose a short-term discount/commit to keep them through renewal window.

Lin: For the deck we can use per-route P95 latency, per-token cost (hosted vs dedicated), and a forecast showing impact of batching & KV caching turned on. I can draft bullets.

Diego: Note: we can recommend turning on prefix caching for their common flows — should cut tokens by ~12-18% for their chat-heavy pipeline. I can include before/after sims.

Raj: Pricing ask — what's our short-term retention play? Nora, any flexibility on a 3-month bridge credit vs a long-term commit?

Nora: Sales can offer a 12% credit on overage for Q2 if they sign a 6mo extension before renewal, or a 6% one-off credit without an extension. I'll confirm legal.

Maya: I'll schedule a 30m enablement call with new procurement lead and Elena. Proposed times: tomorrow 10:30am or 3:00pm PT. Who from eng should join?

Diego: I can join the 10:30 slot and run a quick ops demo (cache + batching).

Lin: I'll join to cover latency/cost tradeoffs and the optimization checklist.

Nora: I'll come for the commercial Qs.

Maya: Great. I'll send invite and a 1-slide pre-read. Also attaching recent usage snapshot:
- 30d tokens: 3.1M (down from 5.2M)
- Avg tokens/session: 420 -> 310
- Active seats: 120 -> 73

Maya: Action items: @Diego run charts + caching sim (ETA 45m); @Lin draft procurement slide + optimization checklist (ETA EOD); @Nora confirm commercial credit options w/legal (ETA EOD); @Maya schedule call + prep pre-read (ETA next 2h).

renewal-bot: Note: Account health score dropped from 81 -> 62 in last 7 days. Flagged for "at-risk" workflows.

Raj: One more ask — can we surface the top 10 most active prefixes so we can show caching wins for their exact flows?

Diego: Yep, will include prefix heatmap in the chart exports.

Maya: If we can lock the enablement call and share the deck before the procurement lead meets SkyServe, we stand a good chance. I'll post invite + agenda in this thread. :crossed_fingers: 

Nora: Thanks team. I'll follow up in CRM with the proposed credit terms and link to the calendar invite.

Lin: If we need a follow-up technical deep-dive, I'd recommend a 60m session with data sample QA.

Maya: Agreed. For now keep communication tight — I'll update thread after the call is scheduled.

Diego: Charts posted: https://redwood.internal/snapshots/TRE-001/usage-1805550001.png (will push CSV shortly).

Maya: Perfect — thanks everyone.

Nora: +1.
